name: risk-off-pilot
description: Independent incident assurance for onchain vault operations

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @risk-off/api" "npm run dev -w @risk-off/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @risk-off/core && npm run build -w @risk-off/api && npm run build -w @risk-off/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @risk-off/core && npm run test -w @risk-off/api
